args.summary: Created /workspace/p95.py which reads log directories containing app.log files (including .gz variants), parses both JSON and legacy formats, deduplicates by request_id keeping the latest timestamp, computes per-user failure counts and p95 latency using nearest-rank method, and outputs sorted CSV.
